title.original: The Art of Building Verifiers for Computer Use Agents
title.zh: 为计算机使用代理构建验证器的艺术
title.en: The Art of Building Verifiers for Computer Use Agents

inclusion_reason.zh: Universal Verifier 提供准则、过程/结果奖励和长轨迹视觉上下文的完整验证栈，可复用于训练与评测。
inclusion_reason.en: The Universal Verifier provides an integrated stack for rubrics, process/outcome rewards, and long visual traces that can be reused in training and evaluation.

abstract.zh: Universal Verifier 面向计算机使用轨迹，把互斥评分准则、过程/结果奖励、故障可控性和全截图上下文管理组合为可复用验证系统。
abstract.en: The Universal Verifier combines non-overlapping rubrics, process/outcome rewards, failure controllability, and full-screenshot context management into reusable verification for computer-use trajectories.

problem.zh: 若轨迹成功验证含噪或只看终态，Agent 评测与训练奖励都会误判被环境阻塞、路径异常或偶然成功的行为。
problem.en: Noisy or outcome-only trajectory verification mislabels environmentally blocked, unexpectedly routed, or accidentally successful behavior, corrupting both evaluation and training rewards.

approach.zh: 作者拆分互补的过程与结果标准，以无级联错误策略区分可控/不可控失败，并分治处理长轨迹的全部截图。
approach.en: The design separates complementary process and outcome criteria, scores controllable versus uncontrollable failures without cascade penalties, and divide-and-conquers all screenshots in long traces.

system_design.zh: 验证器包含准则构造器、分段视觉上下文摘要、过程评分器、结果评分器、故障归因器及聚合决策层，并配套双标签基准。
system_design.en: The verifier includes rubric construction, segmented visual-context handling, process and outcome scorers, failure attribution, and an aggregation layer, backed by a dual-labeled benchmark.

key_results.zh: 组合设计使系统与人工的一致度接近人工互评，并将相较既有 Web 验证器的误报压到极低水平。
key_results.en: The combined design reaches agreement comparable to inter-human agreement and drives false positives far below prior web-task verifiers.

limitations.zh: 经验主要来自 Web 计算机任务；准则设计仍需要专家策略知识，自动研究 Agent 未能发现全部必要规则。
limitations.en: Evidence is primarily from web computer-use tasks; rubric design still requires expert strategy knowledge, and automated research did not recover every necessary rule.
